photos.llama_desc: A man in a white shirt and black tie standing on a stage with two people in animal costumes. The man is standing in front of a large, darkly lit stage with a few people in the background. The man is wearing a white shirt, black tie, and dark pants.
photos.oracle_desc: A teenage boy in a white dress shirt and black tie stands center stage between two performers in animal costumes — one in a green-and-yellow creature suit on the left and one in a white bunny-like suit on the right. The stage is dark with a simple door-frame flat as the only set piece. No audience members are visible in the frame.

photos.llama_desc: Two young girls in matching white t-shirts with a red, white, and blue star on the front, standing in a grassy area with a sidewalk and a blue car in the background. The girl on the left has her hair in a ponytail and is wearing a pair of black-framed glasses. The girl on the right has a red, white, and blue hair bow in her hair.
photos.oracle_desc: Two girls wearing matching white t-shirts with a patriotic sequined star graphic pose together outdoors on a grassy lawn, with a parked blue vehicle visible in the background. The older girl on the left wears black-framed glasses and has her hair pulled back, while the younger girl on the right sports a large red, white, and blue bow in her hair. Both girls are smiling at the camera.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a red Santa hat and red coat, holding a bell, standing in front of a group of children in a room with a Christmas tree and a table with books and toys. The children are all dressed in various Christmas-themed clothing, including red and green, and some are holding small toys or books. The room is decorated with a Christmas tree and a table with books and toys, and there is an American flag in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: A woman in a red jacket and red Santa hat gestures with one hand toward a large group of young children gathered around a small decorated Christmas tree in what appears to be a classroom or community meeting room. The children, dressed in casual and festive clothing, cluster together facing the tree, and an American flag stands in the background near the wall. No bell is visible in the woman's hand.

photos.llama_desc: A group of women and a young girl in a pink leotard sitting on a gymnastics beam in a gym. The women are all wearing blue t-shirts with green text on them, and one of them is wearing a pink t-shirt. The girl is wearing a pink leotard and has a bandage on her knee.
photos.oracle_desc: A toddler girl in a pink leotard sits on a low gymnastics balance beam, surrounded by five women all wearing matching teal-blue t-shirts with green logo text, in a gym decorated with fall harvest wall cutouts. Four of the women lean against the beam in front while one stands behind, and everyone is smiling at the camera. No pink t-shirt is visible among the group and no bandage is apparent on the child's knee.

photos.llama_desc: A young woman in a green dress and high heels, holding a white and green corsage, standing with a young man in a black tuxedo, green bow tie, and white shirt, in front of a tree with a large trunk and green leaves.
photos.oracle_desc: A teenage couple dressed for a formal occasion poses outdoors beneath a large tree — the young man wears a black tuxedo with a green bow tie and the young woman wears a dark green dress with heeled sandals. A white floral boutonniere is pinned to the young man's lapel, and the young woman appears to wear a wrist corsage. They stand close together on a paved path with leafy greenery filling the background.

photos.llama_desc: Two people in a darkened theater watching a stage show with a large, green, glowing, and spiky, flower-like, or plant-like, structure in the center of the stage.
photos.oracle_desc: A darkened theater stage features two large spiky green illuminated plant-like set pieces — resembling glowing alien or tropical plants — along with angular geometric prop shapes on the stage floor. The entire scene is lit in deep green against a black background with no audience members visible in the frame. The image appears to be a photograph of the stage itself rather than a view from the audience.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a pink and yellow swimsuit sits in a sandcastle on a beach, throwing sand in the air. She has long blonde hair and is wearing a pink and yellow swimsuit with a yellow and pink beach towel around her neck. The sandcastle is made of several large and small pieces of sand, with some of it being thrown in the air.
photos.oracle_desc: A young blonde girl in a pink swimsuit sits cross-legged in the sand next to a small sandcastle on a beach, patting or scooping sand with one hand while looking toward the camera. An orange plastic bucket sits in the background and another person's legs are visible at the far left edge of the frame. No beach towel is visible around her neck, and the swimsuit appears solid pink rather than pink and yellow.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a black dress with pink flowers, holding a bunch of purple balloons in a living room with a couch, a brick fireplace, and a TV. She is standing on a rug with a floral pattern, holding the balloons with both hands. The room has a TV on a TV stand, a lamp on a table, and a fireplace with a few framed photos on the mantel.
photos.oracle_desc: A toddler girl in a black velvet dress with light floral embroidery along the hem stands in a living room holding a large bunch of lavender balloons by their ribbons with both hands. Behind her, a floral-patterned sofa, a brick fireplace with framed photos on the mantel, and a lamp on a side table furnish the room. The dress trim appears white or light-colored rather than pink.

photos.llama_desc: A red train car with three children sitting in it, looking out at something. The train car is red and has a metal pole running along its top. The children are all wearing different outfits: a girl in a pink dress, a boy in a white t-shirt, and a girl in a pink and white checkered dress.
photos.oracle_desc: Three children — a boy and two girls — sit together in a red carnival ride car at what appears to be an outdoor fair or amusement area, with a crowd of onlookers visible in the background. The children are looking toward the camera rather than away, and the middle girl wears a pink top with a large pink bow in her hair. The ride car is styled with a chrome-bar top rail and resembles a fairground attraction rather than a train.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a white dress crouing next to a birdbath in a garden. She is holding a small blue bird in her hands. The woman is wearing a white dress and has long dark hair.
photos.oracle_desc: Two young women in light-colored summer dresses crouch side by side on a stone-paved garden path next to a concrete birdbath, smiling at the camera. No bird is present in the scene; both women's hands are empty and resting near the ground. The young woman on the right wears a graduation medal or ribbon lanyard around her neck.
